blocks.text: FAQs – Microwave Removal

items.q: Do you remove all types of microwaves?
a: Yes! We remove countertop, over-the-range, built-in, and commercial microwaves. Our team handles all brands and models, including units requiring special removal techniques for safe extraction.

items.q: How much does same day microwave removal cost?
a: Prices vary by microwave type and location. We offer free, no-obligation quotes with transparent pricing. Contact us for an accurate estimate based on your specific removal needs.

items.q: Do you recycle or properly dispose of old microwaves?
a: Absolutely. We follow strict e-waste recycling protocols, ensuring 95 %+ of materials are properly recycled. All components are disposed of responsibly at certified recycling facilities.

items.q: What areas do you serve for microwave removal?
a: We serve all Toronto neighborhoods, including Downtown, North York, Scarborough, Etobicoke, and the surrounding Greater Toronto Area areas. Call to confirm service availability in your specific location.

items.q: Can I schedule a same-day pickup?
a: Yes! Same-day service is available when booked by noon. Next-day appointments are also easy to schedule for your convenience throughout the week.
